verdict.rationale: Phaser's docs show built-in Arcade Physics that drives sprites out of the box with velocity, acceleration and gravity. They also call it lightweight, limited to rectangle and circle shapes, and say it has inherent limitations. A community user and the editor's physics-body tooling corroborate that physics is a core feature, but the evidence never shows full rigid-body dynamics, explicit collision APIs or raycasting. Missing for 10: evidence of a true rigid-body engine, documented collision detection/response, raycast support, and support for complex body shapes.
